name: Wattrel
description: Wattrel, the Storm Petrel Pokémon. Able to evolve into Kilowattrel. An Electric and Flying type.
pokedex_entries: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.
